none: PAS NLM-22C043: Roman Coin: Radiate of Tetricus from Binbrook
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy with silver wash. Coin. Radiate of Tetricus II (272-274), Reece period 13. Obverse description: Radiate bust cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: [--]TRIC[--]AVG. Reverse description: Possibly figure standing left. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin, which has lost circa one third of its area. Diameter: 21.2mm, Weight: 1.57gms, die axis: possibly 6
